summary:
Ultra-minimalist redesign of the in-game investigation experience successfully implemented:
- Clean, single-row top navigation showing only Detective Name, Role, and Envelope Number (removing all simulator switcher buttons, unread counters, and sound toggles).
- Complete removal of the 'Diğer Dedektifteki Dosyalar' tab; players verbally share evidence at the table without phone screen distraction.
- Realistic police dossier document with official typewriter report, key deduction, and a single 'Panoya Yansıt' button, eliminating complex multi-widget lab clutter.
- Streamlined envelope verification and advancement bar.
